_doc: Minimal typed SimpleListDetails request for xpp_create_form.
Substitute the form name, backing table, and field set for your case.
STRUCTURE (must match MS's example.xml in this folder): the design's direct
children are PEERS — ActionPane, the NavigationList group (style=SidePanel),
DetailsHeader (FieldsFieldGroups group), and DetailsTab (FastTabs). There is
NO 'Details' wrapper group, and SidePanel goes on the NAV group, not the
details. Nesting DetailsHeader/DetailsTab inside a SidePanel wrapper breaks
the two-pane layout at RUNTIME even though BP + compile pass (valid XML,
wrong layout) — verify any new form's render via chrome-mcp.
_doc keys are ignored by the tool — strip them before sending if your serializer is strict.
name: MyEntitySetupForm

controls._doc: NavigationList: the left/master pane. style=SidePanel docks it left; heightMode fills the pane. NOTE: this group declares NO Pattern — the SL+D pattern requires its children (Quick Filter + the list Grid) directly; the nav group itself does not take a sub-pattern. (Declaring a bogus one like 'NavigationListSimpleListAndDetails' fails compile with UnableToValidatePattern.)
controls.name: NavigationList

controls._doc: Quick Filter — REQUIRED *direct* child of the nav group (not nested in another group). It's a base AxFormControl (kind=Other, no i:type of its own) whose behavior lives in a FormControlExtension named 'QuickFilterControl': targetControlName = the grid it filters, defaultColumnName = the grid column (named <Grid>_<field>). This exact shape is what the SL+D pattern's required 'Quick Filter' slot expects.
controls.name: QuickFilterControl

controls._doc: Master Grid: 2-3 fields per row (ID + Name in this example).
controls.name: Grid

controls._doc: DetailsHeader: TOP-LEVEL peer (not nested). List fields appear here first in list order, then the rest of the entity's fields.
controls.name: DetailsHeader

controls._doc: DetailsTab: TOP-LEVEL peer. FastTabs for additional detail sections. Empty here; add tab pages for related collections, history, etc.
controls.name: DetailsTab
